profile_text.body:
Lovable is a software company founded in 2023 that operates an AI-powered platform for building apps, websites, and digital products. The company describes its platform as accessible to users without deep coding skills, positioning it as a tool that allows individuals and teams to iterate on ideas and ship software quickly.

The platform's core product, also called Lovable, is categorized as a coding and developer tool focused on app generation. The company's site frames it as suitable for both individual problem-solvers and employees at larger organizations, describing use cases that range from personal projects to internal business software.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP server registrations, or SEC disclosures are recorded in the held facts for this company.
